api.name: Processor
api.title: Processor
api.description: A step written in Java: process(exchange) reads and writes the exchange in place, the result goes into exchange.getMessage(). Used as .process(new MyProcessor()) or a lambda, or as a bean (process: {ref: myProcessor}); a plain bean method taking the body (.bean(myBean, "method")) is often simpler than a Processor.

process.description: Processes the exchange in place: read exchange.getMessage().getBody(type), put the result with setBody; throw to fail the exchange.
